title: Planner: AI-generated status reports in Planner Agent
summary: The rollout, licensing and report behaviour agree with Microsoft's notice and the cited documentation. The blocking path stops before the documented Block agent selection, so it needs completing before administrators rely on it. The checklist also names licence and Loop checks absent from the controls table.

claims.claim: The complete blocking path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote: In the Block agent or Unblock agent pane that opens, select either Block agent or Unblock agent, and then select Save.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].ui.path and its rendered table path with 'Agents > All agents > agent > Block > Block agent > Save'. The cited page requires selecting Block agent in the pane after selecting Block; the current path omits that selection, not just the final Save.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id> enables Planner Agent in Planner for a security group.

To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: No admin UI equivalent is documented for the Planner-specific AllowPlannerCopilot and PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner" "AllowPlannerCopilot" "admin center" "settings"; Planner Agent restrict access admin center UI AllowPlannerCopilot security group status reports. Read planner/turn-off-planner-agent and manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps; no UI for these Planner configuration fields.

claims.quote: restrict access to the Planner Agent experience for task execution and status reporting in both basic and premium plans

claims.claim: The cited documentation does not establish that the Planner PowerShell setting governs the new reports in Planner Agent in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Agent restrict access admin center UI AllowPlannerCopilot security group status reports. Read planner/turn-off-planner-agent and manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps; the former separates Planner from Microsoft Copilot management and does not identify roadmap 567886.

Read cited pages and Purview Planner activities search excerpts; no status-report-generation event or dedicated report identified.
